data.text:
Afzal Khan vs State Of Up And 2 Others on 10 September, 2024 
Author: Saumitra Dayal Singh
Bench: Saumitra Dayal Singh
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:147658-Db
Court No. - 39
Case :- Writ - C No. - 30106 of 2024
Petitioner :- Afzal Khan
Respondent :- State Of Up And 2 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Asar Mukhtar,Ikram Ahmad 
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Saumitra Dayal Singh,J.
Hon'ble Donadi Ramesh,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the parties. 
2. Petitioner's statutory appeal filed under Section 32(4)(c) of the Food Safety and Standards Act,
2006 arising from the order dated 21.05.2024, is described to be pending before respondent No.3 since 01.07.2024. 
3. Without entering into the merits of the case, this petition is disposed of subject to the petitioner filing a copy of this order before the respondent No.3. The said respondent No.3 will deal with and decide the petitioner's appeal after hearing all the necessary parties as expeditiously as possible Afzal Khan vs State Of Up And 2 Others on 10 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/194294231/
1 preferably within a period of one month from the date of compliance shown by the petitioner.
